description.narrative: • Sofala Capital is a holding company that seeds and builds lending businesses focusing on affordable housing, with current operations of its investee companies in South Africa and Zambia. • IBuild Home Loans provides micro-building mortgages to low-income South African homeowners who want to extend their homes to earn rental income, using in-house mechanisms to mitigate risks. • ZHL is the first building finance mortgage lender in Zambia licensed as a NBFI (non-bank financial institution), targeting mostly building projects that are partially completed.

• The debt to ZHL was advanced to grow the US$ denominated portion of the loan book. This has proven useful given the depreciation of the Zambian Kwacha which has resulted in an increase in interest rates and consequently reduced the viability of local currency loans. The loan was disbursed on 30 June 2018 as part of an independent series of the ZMW 45 million medium term note. It yields a net interest of 5% per annum and has a tenor of 7 years. • The equity investment into IBHL and ZHL was to form a buffer upon which to build leverage and grow the business. For IBHL, the equity was also used by Sofala to increase its stake through exercising a call option that had been entered into with Praesidium.

activity-date.narrative: The exit of FSDAi’s indirect exposure in iBuild Home Loans was completed in January 2023
